[size=5]Animated User Interface: All-In-One![/size][/b][/color][/u]

[size=2]Are you looking at your UI like: wow this is pretty static, I wish it moved a bit... Look no further! Animate the entire UI! Stationary most of the time, but then animates occasionally.


[color=#f1c232] [b]﻿---[/b] [/color]Animates the top inventory tabs (configurable using [color=#1e84cc]"AnimateInventoryTabs"[/color])

[color=#f1c232] [b]﻿---[/b] [/color]Animates the collection's tab side tabs (configurable using [color=#1e84cc]"AnimateInventoryTabs"[/color])

[color=#f1c232][b] ﻿---[/b][/color][color=#f1c232] [/color]Changes the collection's tab side tab's tooltips (configurable using [color=#1e84cc]"DeluxeCollectionTabsTooltips"[/color])

[color=#f1c232][b] ﻿﻿---[/b] [/color]Animates the skills (configurable using [color=#1e84cc]"AnimateInventoryTabs"[/color])

[color=#f1c232] [b]﻿---[/b] [/color]Animates the wallet items (configurable using [color=#1e84cc]"WalletItemsAnimated"[/color])

[color=#f1c232] [b]﻿---[/b] [/color]Adds descriptions to the wallet items on hover (configurable using [color=#1e84cc]"MakeWalletItemInfoVerbose"[/color] and [color=#1e84cc]"TurnOffWalletItemDescriptions"[/color])

[color=#f1c232] [b]﻿---[/b] [/color]Animates the pet icons (configurable using [color=#1e84cc]"AnimatePetIcons"[/color])

[color=#f1c232] [b]﻿---[/b] [/color]Animates the buff icons like defense, immunity, and the skull that shows on inedible items

[color=#f1c232] [b]﻿---[/b] [/color]Adds the dynamic shop status in the upper right (configurable using [color=#1e84cc]"ShopStatusUI"[/color])
[/size]



[img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645779750-777928429.png[/img][size=2][color=#f1c232][b]

[u][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Windows Install:[/b][/size][/color][/u]
1)[/b] [/color]Download, install, or update Stardew Valley.

[color=#f1c232][b]2)[/b] [/color]Download, install, or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url]. (Look on YouTube or [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]here on the wiki[/url]﻿ if you can't figure out how to install SMAPI on Windows)

[b][color=#f1c232]3)[/color][/b] Download, install, or update [u][b]all the other requirements[/b][/u] under the "Requirements" tab above.﻿

[color=#f1c232][b]4)[/b] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]5)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Move the extracted folder into your "SteamLibrary \ steamapps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this:
﻿"SteamLibrary \ steamapps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Mods \ [CP-A] Animated Deluxe UI"[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]6)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size]

[size=2][color=#f1c232][b]
[u][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]MacOS Install:[/b][/size][/color][/u]
1) [/b][/color]Download, install, or update Stardew Valley.

[color=#f1c232][b]2)[/b] [/color]Download, install, or update [url=http://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]. (Look on YouTube or [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Mac]here on the wiki﻿[/url] if you can't figure out how to install SMAPI on MacOS)

[b][color=#f1c232]3)[/color][/b] Download, install, or update [u][b]all the other requirements[/b][/u] under the "Requirements" tab above.﻿

[color=#f1c232][b]4)[/b] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]5)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Move the extracted folder into your "Library \ Application Support \ Steam \ SteamApps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Contents \ MacOS \ Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this:
﻿"Library \ Application Support \ Steam \ SteamApps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Contents \ MacOS \ Mods \ [CP-A] Animated Deluxe UI"[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]6)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size]
